data.body:
**[P1] Fail closed when the host cannot advertise the local carrier**

A missing property currently permits `_X_AMZN_TRACE_ID` fallback, but the package still accepts core 2.4–2.6/API v1, whose `InvocationInfo` always lacks this property. On Managed Instances that process header may belong to another invocation, silently attaching spans to the wrong trace. Require core 2.7+—including for separate-layer loading—or add a host capability/version marker and disable this fallback when the host cannot distinguish true carrier absence.
